headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 Net Profit Rises 29% as Margins Narrow
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 29% year-on-year increase in standalone net profit to Rs 4,212 crore for the July-September quarter, alongside a 16% rise in net interest income and a narrowing net interest margin.
why: Quarterly earnings reports from major private banks provide key insights into credit growth, lending margins, and overall financial sector health.

impacts.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
impacts.why: A 29% profit increase reflects solid quarterly performance despite narrowing margins.

why_moved: Solid profit expansion and higher net interest income beat baseline expectations, driving positive sentiment despite narrowing net interest margins.
